sentences.text:
Shalk Mohammad, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 24 July,
2020

Author: M.Ganga Rao
Bench: M.Ganga Rao
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Ganga Rao
 Criminal Petition No.2827 Of 2020
Order:

-
The petitioners/A-18 to A-21 seek to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.190 of 2020 of Kavali I Town Police Station, Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273 and 328 I.P.C. and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Kavali I Town Police Station, Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the issue involved in this criminal petition is squarely covered by a common order of this Court in Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch, dated 18.12.2019.

4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State fairly conceded that it is a covered matter and earlier cases, which were registered for the similar offences on similar facts,
were quashed by this Court.
5. Following the said order and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal Petition is also allowed in terms thereof.
6. Office to enclose a copy of the said common order.
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.

JUSTICE M.GANGA RAO Date : 24.7.2020 AMD THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE M.GANGA RAO CRIMINAL PETITION No.2827 OF 2020 Date :
